statutes.title: Levy and Rates of Personal Income Tax
statutes.breadcrumbs: Del. Code > Title 30 > Part II > Chapter 11 > Subchapter I > § 1102
text_en: Imposes graduated income tax rates from 2.2% to 6.6% and applies convenience of employer rules to nonresident compensation.
text_es: Impone tasas de impuesto sobre la renta graduadas del 2.2% al 6.6% y aplica reglas de conveniencia del empleador a remuneraciones de no residentes.
